content.value: Connect the output Y of the DTL gate shown in the following figure to N inputs of other similar (13) gates. Assume that the output transistor is saturated and its base current is 0.44 mA. Let $h _ { F E . } =$ 20.
i) Calculate the current in the 2-KΩ resistor.
ii) Calculate the current coming from each input connected to the gate.
iii) Calculate the total collector current in the output transistor as a function of N.
iv) Find the value of N that will keep the transistor in saturation.
v) What is the fan-out of the gate?
